reports.title: Calix Releases Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Fourth Quarter 2026 Guidance
section:
Guidance Non-GAAP | Guidance Reconciled to GAAP
Revenue | $311m – $317m | $311m – $317m
Gross margin | 52.25% – 54.75%1 | 52.0% – 54.5%
Operating expenses | $129.5m – $131.5m1 | $149.5m – $151.5m
Net income per diluted common share2 | $0.41 – $0.491 | $0.17 – $0.25

1 | Non-GAAP excludes stock-based compensation, net of the effect for income tax. See the GAAP to non-GAAP reconciliation on page 18.
2 | Based on 63.4 million weighted-average diluted common shares outstanding.
Our guidance for the fourth quarter of 2026, ending December 31, 2026, reflects our expectations as of the date of this letter.

Our revenue guidance for the fourth quarter of 2026 is for revenue to be between $311 million and $317 million, up 4% (at the midpoint) from the prior quarter and resulting in full-year 2026 revenue growth of approximately 19%, at the higher end of our 15% to 20% growth expectations provided at the beginning of the year. This outlook reflects the demand and visibility we are seeing across our customer base and the expected revenue impact from memory surcharges intended to partially offset memory cost increases.

Non-GAAP gross margin guidance of 52.25% to 54.75% for the fourth quarter represents the same level at the midpoint as the prior quarter. The gross margin guidance primarily reflects continued increases in
memory component costs, which we expect surcharges to be partially offset by surcharges to a greater degree than in the prior quarter and, to a lesser extent, by customer and product mix.

Our non-GAAP operating expense guidance for the fourth quarter of 2026 of $129.5 million to $131.5 million reflects investments related to our annual ConneXions customer and innovation conference and five additional days in the quarter, partially offset by anticipated productivity benefits.
We continue to expect our non-GAAP effective income tax rate for 2026 will be in a range of 23% to 25%.
